filters.hint: Click any value on the page to filter — no typing needed
kpi.no_counters: No interface counters to compare yet
ov.bw_sub_week: Dashed line: same time last week
ov.top_clients_sub: The side that opened the connection
conv.slow: long ranges read all flow detail and can take a while; 1 hour is fastest
topn.title: Top {n}
topn.rollup_note: Long time range: served from hourly summaries, so filters are not available here.
sankey.title: Segment → application → remote country
geo.no_table: No traffic to or from other countries in this time range.
thr.sub: Red: an internal host sent data to a listed address
thr.no_lists: No threat lists loaded. Put one address or network per line in data/threats/<name>.txt and restart.
rec.title: Flow records
if.title: Interfaces
if.no_counters: This device sends no interface counters, so there is nothing to compare with. Add a line like snmp 10.0.0.1 public under Sources → Names to read them over SNMP.
if.ok: Consistent. The flow estimate differs from the device counter by {dev}, within the statistical error of sampling ({err}).
if.low: The flow estimate is {dev} lower than the device counter. Likely causes: {causes}.
if.high: The flow estimate is {dev} higher than the device counter. Likely causes: {causes}.
cause.loss: {p} of this device's export packets were lost on the way
cause.sampling: the sampling rate is not known yet
cause.unsampled_iface: not every interface carrying this traffic is sampled
cause.dup: the same traffic is counted on more than one interface
src.title: Sources
src.sub: Is every device sending, can it be decoded, is the sampling rate right
src.names_sub: Optional. Name networks, devices, interfaces and hosts, one per line.
issue.silent: Nothing received for more than 2 minutes. Check the export destination on the device and that UDP is allowed through firewalls.
issue.waiting_sampling: Templates received but no sampling rate yet. {n} records are held and will be scaled when it arrives, not counted as 1:1. Devices usually resend it within a few minutes.
issue.assumed_unsampled: This device never declared a sampling rate, so its records are counted 1:1. If it samples, make it export sampler options, or mark it 'unsampled' in Names.
issue.loss: {p} of export packets were lost on the way here. Totals are compensated; per-host detail cannot be. Increase the UDP receive buffer on this machine or check the path.
issue.no_template: Data is arriving but its template has not. It is held and decoded as soon as the template arrives.
issue.clock_skew: The device clock is off by {s}. Times were corrected to arrival time.
issue.decode_errors: Some datagrams could not be decoded. Check that the device sends to the right port and protocol.
empty.first: Nothing received yet. Send sFlow to UDP 6343, NetFlow to 2055 or IPFIX to 4739 on this machine.
err.db_memory: The database reached its memory limit and could not answer. Choose a shorter time range, or start traffic66 with a larger -memory.
err.db_busy: The database could not answer just now; the reason is in the traffic66 log. The page tries again in 30 seconds.
login.title: Sign in
tui.help: ↑↓ select  Enter actions  f only  x exclude  / search  t time  1-8 pages  c clear  w browser  q quit
tui.login: Login required: start with -user and -password, or run on the traffic66 machine
pop.name: Name it…
pop.named: Saved; the name now shows everywhere
topn.hint: Click any column heading to sort. Number columns rank all traffic in the time range, not just the rows shown.
self.need: Keeping {d} days of detail needs about {n} at the current rate
self.need_later: Keeping {d} days of detail: the space needed is estimated once there is a day of data
geo.title: Countries and networks database
geo.sub: Shows the country and network (AS) of each remote address
geo.none: No database yet, so countries and networks show as Unknown. Upload one below.
geo.installed: Installed as {f}. It applies to new traffic from now on.
geo.where: Accepted: .mmdb files (DB-IP, MaxMind GeoLite2, IPinfo Lite; countries, networks or both) and IP-to-ASN tables (.tsv or .tsv.gz). Your own files are used first; the built-in DB-IP Lite answers the rest. Traffic already stored keeps the country it was saved with.
src.names_help: Easiest: click any address on any page and choose “Name it”. You can also write one entry per line here, for example:
fd.none: Nothing was found in this time range.
fd.none_open: No open findings: nothing needs attention.
fd.learning: Learning what is normal until {t}. Connections between your hosts and uploads to new destinations are reported after that.
fd.note: Checked every 5 minutes. With sampled data (sFlow, sampled NetFlow) the numbers are what the samples show, and a small scan can go unseen.
fd.false_tip: This will not be reported again
fd.k.brute: {src} tried to log in to {dst} ({port}) again and again
fd.k.lateral: {src} opened {port} sessions to {n} hosts that never offered this service before
fd.k.exfil: {src} uploaded {bytes} to {dst}, a destination it had not used before
fd.k.threat_out: {src} connected to {dst}, which is on the threat list “{list}”
fd.k.threat_in: {src}, on the threat list “{list}”, connected to {dst}
logo.title: Logo
logo.sub: Shown on the sign-in page and at the top of the menu
logo.hint: PNG, SVG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, up to 1 MB. Best at 272 × 92 pixels; other sizes are scaled to fit.
geo.role_fallback: Used where the others have no answer
geo.remove_confirm: Remove {f}? What it held then comes from the other databases and the built-in DB-IP Lite.
geo.updated: Updated. New traffic uses it from now on.
geo.update_failed: Could not download: {e}. Download the files yourself and upload them.
geo.free_sub: Download one and upload it here. DB-IP Lite is already built in.
geo.f_dbip: Countries and networks. No sign-up, updated monthly. Built in; “Update DB-IP Lite now” fetches the latest.
geo.f_maxmind: Countries and networks (GeoLite2-Country and GeoLite2-ASN). Needs a free MaxMind account.
geo.f_ipinfo: Countries and networks in one file (ipinfo_lite.mmdb). Needs a free IPinfo account.
geo.f_iptoasn: Networks with their country (ip2asn-combined.tsv.gz). No sign-up, updated hourly.
geo.map_sub: {n} countries · darker means more traffic · click a country to filter
